The maps give information on the layout of a college cafe before and
after being redesigned.
Overall, there have been many changes made to the cafe, with the most
noticeable ones being the addition of a new outdoor seating area and
the reorganization of the food service area into dedicated sections.
As for the indoor area, before the redesign, upon entering the cafe via
the double door located in the top-right corner of the layout, visitors
could immediately see the two staff dining rooms. These have been
converted into a take-away food section and a coffee bar. There was a
single bin to the left of the entrance, and toilets in the corner, while
tables and chairs were placed in the middle of the building. The bin has
been replaced with multiple recycling bins, while the toilets, tables, and
